missions.title: Repo Roulette
missions.summary: Gulfline Finance pays per hook and does not care how the hook happens. Nico passes along the work sheet: a vehicle whose owner is three payments behind and extremely attached to it. Repeatable; the target and the district rotate.

steps.label: Collect tonight's repossession order from Nico's booth at the Carrusel
Take the flatbed to the delinquent owner's address in Crown Shore
Hook the financed SUV off the driveway before the owner gets outside
The owner has reported it stolen: lose the patrol car until dispatch reads the paperwork
Deliver the SUV to the Gulfline Finance lot in Saltgrass County with the paint intact

missions.title: Causeway Sprint
missions.summary: Jun wants numbers on his coupe before he touches the cam timing again. One timed run the length of the Odile Causeway and back to the bay, with a brother in the passenger seat narrating your mistakes.

steps.label: Pick up the coupe and Jun from his bay in Cypress Heights
Listen to the pre-run briefing
lines: Jun: New cam, new plugs, same idiot driving. Let's get a baseline.
Cass: You could drive it yourself.
Jun: I could. Then who would I blame?

steps.label: Run the Odile Causeway flat out to the Saltgrass toll plaza
Turn round and beat your outbound time back to Cypress Heights

missions.title: The Loop
missions.summary: Nico is running a book on a full lap of the I-9 Loop: Paseo to Meridian Center to Eastbank to the Neon Mile, any vehicle, no rules, one clock. He has money on you, which he says is a compliment.

steps.label: Line up at the I-9 on-ramp behind the Paseo District
First sector: the I-9 Loop to the Meridian Center interchange
Second sector: through the construction chicanes to the Eastbank exit
Final sector: hold it together down to the Neon Mile off-ramp
The highway patrol noticed: lose them before you collect

missions.title: Cold Chain
missions.summary: The Mercy Street clinic's fridge has died with a week of insulin inside it. Toby has found a working unit at the Cypress Heights school and a pharmacist at the port willing to release replacement stock, if someone can move both before the afternoon heat.

steps.label: Get the run sheet from Toby
lines: Toby: Fridge died at four this morning. I've got six hours of ice and a lot of diabetics.
Cass: Where's the stock?
Toby: Port dispensary. Where's the fridge? Cypress Heights. Where's the driver? I'm looking at them.

steps.label: Collect two insulated crates from the Ironhook seafarers' dispensary
Reach the Cypress Heights school before the crates warm up
Load the donated medical fridge onto the flatbed
Deliver the fridge and the stock to the Mercy Street clinic, gently

missions.title: Ice Run
missions.summary: The fish house always needs ice brought in from the trawlers, and the harbor patrol always has questions about what is under it. A short night boat job for Mama Tide. Repeatable; the pick-up point moves with the fleet.

steps.label: Take a skiff from the fish-house slip on Ironhook Pier 2
Cross the bay to the trawler standing off Pelican Marina
Load three iced fish totes without asking what else is in them
A harbor patrol launch lights you up: lose it among the moored yachts
Bring the totes home to the fish-house slip

missions.title: Blue Light Special
missions.summary: A seized sedan in the Harbor Unit impound has a second set of books taped under the spare wheel, and it is scheduled for the crusher on Friday. Detective Brandt cannot sign it out without Halloran's clerk seeing the form. A tow driver, on the other hand, moves cars for a living.

steps.label: Meet Brandt on level four
lines: Brandt: Gray sedan, bay eleven, Harbor Unit impound. It gets crushed Friday.
Cass: And you want it not crushed.
Brandt: I want it parked on level four of this garage by midnight. I do not want to know how.
Cass: That's the nicest thing a cop has ever asked me to steal.

steps.label: Get into the Harbor Unit impound lot behind Ironhook Gate 2
Take the gray sedan from bay eleven
The Harbor Unit wants its evidence back: lose them
Leave the sedan on level four of the courthouse garage in Meridian Center

missions.title: The Stamp Collector
missions.summary: Priya is two liens short of proving that one notary stamped every forged consent form in Eastbank on the same afternoon. The notices are still stapled to the doors of houses whose owners have already been moved out. She needs photographs, and she needs them before the demolition crews do their own tidying.

steps.label: Meet Priya at the fence line of Eastbank Phase Two
Photograph four lien notices on the doors of the cleared Eastbank row houses
Photograph the two newest notices on the Flats frontage
Bring the memory card to Priya's table at the Carrusel
Compare the stamps with Priya
lines: Priya: Look at the date. All six. Same day, same pen, same coffee ring on the stamp pad.
Cass: He did two hundred of these in one afternoon?
Priya: He did them in one lunch. I've seen the receipt. He had the fish.

missions.title: Slack Tide
missions.summary: Old Sal has not been out on the water since the chain went on the gate. He will not ask. Take him up the Saltgrass channel in his own skiff, cut the engine at slack tide and let him talk about Inés, or not talk, which with Sal is much the same thing.

steps.label: Find Sal on his boat at the foot of Pier 9
Take Sal's aluminum skiff up the Saltgrass channel to the old oyster beds
Cut the engine. Fish. Say nothing for a while.
Let Sal talk
lines: Sal: Your mother raised a forty-foot trawler off this bar with two air bags and a borrowed winch.
Cass: You've told me.
Sal: I'm telling you again. She did it because the man had no insurance and three kids. Never billed him.
Sal: That's the yard, kid. Not the fence. Not the deed. That. And yes, I know I've got a bite. I'm making a point.

steps.label: Run the skiff home to Pier 9 before the tide turns

missions.title: Block Party
missions.summary: Three years to the day since Odile, Mercy Street is throwing a party, on the grounds that the alternative is a memorial. Toby needs a generator, a sound system and forty folding tables moved across town by somebody with a flatbed and no talent for saying no.

steps.label: Borrow the sound system from the Lantern Room's loading dock on the Neon Mile
Pick up the generator and the folding tables from the Cypress Heights school
Bring everything to Mercy Street without shedding a single table
Help run the cables while the street fills up
Take the plate Toby hands you
lines: Toby: Three years ago tonight this street was a river and you were on a roof.
Cass: You were on the same roof.
Toby: I was. I remember thinking, if we get down from here, I'm never going to be quiet again.
Cass: And you haven't been.
Toby: Not for a minute. Eat. You look like you're about to go and do something stupid.

missions.title: Wreck Rights
missions.summary: Navarro Salvage is chained, but the tug Inés is moored outside the fence and a salvage license is a salvage license. Sal reads the Coast Guard notices every morning: there is always something sunk off Sol Strand that an insurer will pay to have raised. Repeatable honest work, such as it is.

steps.label: Board the salvage tug Inés at the outer mooring of Pier 9
Take the tug out to the wreck marker off Sol Strand
Set three lift bags on the sunken hull
Hold station while the hull comes up
Tow the wreck slowly to the insurer's berth at Pelican Marina

missions.title: Shoulder Season
missions.summary: Random world event. A family car has overheated on the shoulder of the Odile Causeway with the tide coming up through the expansion joints and a state tow contractor quoting four hundred dollars, cash, in advance. Cass is driving past with an empty flatbed.

steps.label: Pull over behind the stranded sedan on the Causeway approach
Winch the family's sedan onto the flatbed (they are in the cab with you; it only counts as stealing to the state contractor)
The contractor has called his friend in the highway patrol: lose the cruiser
Drop the car and the family at Jun's garage in Cypress Heights

missions.title: King Tide
missions.summary: Random world event. On a cloudless afternoon the highest tide of the month comes up through the storm drains of the Flats, as it has every month since Odile broke the outfall. Six parked cars are about to become insurance claims their owners cannot make. There is a flatbed, a winch and about four minutes per car.

steps.label: Get the flatbed to the low end of Mercy Street before the water reaches the door sills
Winch three cars out of the flooding curb lane
Carry them up to dry ground at the Cypress Heights park-and-ride
Get back down for the rest before the tide peaks
Pull the last three cars clear
